title: NEGATIVE-PROMPT-DRIVEN ALIGNMENT FOR GENERATIVE LANGUAGE MODEL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation of model alignment with human preferences and values using an open-source proxy reward model (FsfairX-LLaMA3-RM-v0.1) and an LLM-as-a-judge (Claude-3.5-sonnet) on the Anthropic Helpful and Harmless (HH-RLHF) dataset.
